description.content:
The Nomba Charge API provides direct card charging capabilities for developers building payment solutions. It supports submitting customer card details, OTP verification, retrieving user saved cards, and managing the server-to-server card payment flow. This API is designed for merchants and platforms that need programmatic control over the card payment process, including handling 3D Secure authentication steps.
